Alistar.watch: Watch for Alistar W Headbutt into Alistar Q Pulverize to knock you up, then Alistar E Trample to stun you. Blitzcrank has no ability to escape on his own, so manage your distance from Alistar first. Near a turret, don’t give Alistar room to circle behind you.
Alistar.build: Getting caught by Alistar's crowd control is dangerous, so consider building tenacity first. Build magic resistance against the damage from Alistar Q Pulverize, Alistar W Headbutt, and Alistar E Trample.
Alistar.fight: Close the gap and fight right after Alistar Q Pulverize and Alistar W Headbutt are used. If Alistar R Unbreakable Will is active, do not commit your abilities to the attack. Back off and fight again after it ends.
Alistar.laning: Control bush vision to conceal the range of Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab, and look for an angle when Alistar is away from the minions. If Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab is on cooldown, do not step forward; retreat and protect farming.
Alistar.combo: If Alistar W Headbutt is down, pull him in with Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab. Activate Blitzcrank E Power Fist just before the grab hits to knock him up as soon as he arrives. If your allies can follow up and you need an immediate silence, finish with Blitzcrank R Static Field.
Alistar.escape: Right after Alistar W Headbutt is used is your chance to engage. If Alistar Q Pulverize is also down, close in with Blitzcrank W Overdrive and knock him up first with Blitzcrank E Power Fist. Land Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab when he starts to flee.
Alistar.teamfight: Do not spend time trying to kill Alistar while Alistar R Unbreakable Will is active. Target the damage dealer behind him. New crowd control still affects Alistar after he activates his ultimate, so use Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab or Blitzcrank E Power Fist if you need to stop his engage.

Ashe.watch: Ashe W Volley is area slow poke, so sidestep it. Keep your distance while Ashe Q Ranger's Focus is active. When Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow comes your way, change direction instead of running straight away.
Ashe.build: Ashe's main damage is physical, so build armor first. Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow deals magic damage, which armor cannot block. Increasing your maximum mana also strengthens Blitzcrank P Mana Barrier.
Ashe.fight: Trade after Ashe W Volley is used and Ashe Q Ranger's Focus ends. Do not walk in while taking the slow from every Ashe P Frost Shot basic attack; pull her in with Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab to close the gap.
Ashe.laning: Control the bush to conceal the range of Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab, and look for a grab when Ashe is away from the minions. If Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab is down, do not step forward; retreat and protect farming.
Ashe.combo: Pull Ashe in with Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab, knock her up with Blitzcrank E Power Fist, then finish with Blitzcrank R Static Field. Activate Blitzcrank E Power Fist just before Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab hits to knock her up as soon as she arrives.
Ashe.escape: Ashe has no mobility ability to create distance, so right after Ashe W Volley is used is your chance to engage. If Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow is also down, find a Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab angle from the bush or approach with Blitzcrank W Overdrive and land Blitzcrank E Power Fist.
Ashe.teamfight: When your allies can follow up immediately, land Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab on Ashe to pull her in, then knock her up with Blitzcrank E Power Fist. After engaging, stay on her and keep up the pressure with Blitzcrank W Overdrive and Blitzcrank E Power Fist.

Braum.watch: If Braum Q Winter's Bite or a basic attack applies a Braum P Concussive Blows stack, move out of range before the stun triggers. While Braum E Unbreakable blocks the front, wait for a Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab angle. Watch the cast animation of Braum R Glacial Fissure and sidestep its line.
Braum.build: Blitzcrank has no escape ability, so build tenacity first against the stun from Braum P Concussive Blows and the knockup from Braum R Glacial Fissure. Then build magic resistance against Braum's magic damage.
Braum.fight: Engage right after Braum W Stand Behind Me is used. Do not prolong a trade while Braum P Concussive Blows stacks are building on you. When your allies can follow up, briefly lock down a target with Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab and Blitzcrank E Power Fist.
Braum.laning: Stay behind minions to avoid Braum Q Winter's Bite, and control bush vision to conceal the range of Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab. Look for a grab when Braum E Unbreakable ends or Braum W Stand Behind Me is used. Do not step forward while Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab is on cooldown.
Braum.combo: If Braum E Unbreakable has ended and Braum W Stand Behind Me is down, pull him in with Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab. Activate Blitzcrank E Power Fist just before the grab hits to knock him up immediately. Follow with Blitzcrank R Static Field if you need immediate damage or a silence.
Braum.escape: Right after forcing Braum W Stand Behind Me is your window to engage with Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab and Blitzcrank E Power Fist. If you plan to approach with Blitzcrank W Overdrive and land Blitzcrank E Power Fist first, check that Braum's crowd control is down and start near a bush.
Braum.teamfight: Find an angle away from the direction Braum E Unbreakable faces. Use Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab on the target Braum is protecting when your allies can follow up immediately. Avoid the line of Braum R Glacial Fissure and the slow zone it leaves behind. After a successful grab, keep up the pressure with Blitzcrank E Power Fist and Blitzcrank W Overdrive.

Bard.watch: Bard Q Cosmic Binding stuns if it hits a wall or a second target, so do not stand with your back to a wall or in a line with an ally or minion. A target caught in Bard R Tempered Fate takes no damage, so resume attacking after the effect ends.
Bard.build: Get movement speed first so you can position to dodge Bard Q Cosmic Binding. Build magic resistance rather than armor against Bard's damage. If his stun often leaves you open to concentrated attacks, prioritize tenacity. Increasing your maximum mana also strengthens Blitzcrank P Mana Barrier.
Bard.fight: After forcing Bard E Magical Journey, close the gap with Blitzcrank W Overdrive and knock him up with Blitzcrank E Power Fist. It is easier to approach if Bard Q Cosmic Binding is down. Once in range, use Blitzcrank E Power Fist right after a basic attack to follow up quickly.
Bard.combo: After Bard E Magical Journey is used, pull him in with Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab, knock him up with Blitzcrank E Power Fist, then finish with Blitzcrank R Static Field. Activate Blitzcrank E Power Fist just before Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab hits to knock Bard up as soon as he arrives.
Bard.escape: Right after Bard E Magical Journey is used is your window to engage. If Bard Q Cosmic Binding is also down, close in with Blitzcrank W Overdrive, land Blitzcrank E Power Fist first, then use Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab to stop his escape.
Bard.phase: Later in the game, it is hard to finish off a target alone, so fight when your allies can follow up.
Bard.teamfight: Use Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab on a target your allies can attack immediately. After pulling them in, lock them down with Blitzcrank E Power Fist and Blitzcrank R Static Field. If Bard R Tempered Fate has made the target immune to damage, watch for the effect to end so you can resume attacking. After engaging, stay on the target with Blitzcrank W Overdrive to help your allies follow up.
Bard.laning: Control vision in the brush to hide the range of Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab, then throw it when Bard moves away from the minions. Walk over Bard W Caretaker's Shrine on the lane to remove it.

Brand.watch: Dodge Brand W Pillar of Flame and Brand Q Sear first to prevent Brand P Blaze stacks. If you are ablaze, step out of Brand Q Sear’s projectile path or hide behind a minion to avoid the stun. Stay away from burning minions, since Brand E Conflagration can spread from them.
Brand.build: Prioritize movement speed so you can leave telegraphed attack areas. Brand’s main damage is magic, so choose magic resistance if you build resistance. Brand P Blaze deals damage based on maximum health, so avoid building large amounts of health alone.
Brand.fight: Engage after Brand W Pillar of Flame is used and you are not affected by Brand P Blaze. Close the gap with Blitzcrank W Overdrive, knock Brand up with Blitzcrank E Power Fist, then land Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab. Brand has no mobility ability and relatively low magic resistance, so Blitzcrank’s magic damage hits hard once you reach him.
Brand.laning: Control vision in the brush to conceal Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab’s range, and look for a moment when Brand steps away from the minions. Do not stand beside a minion Brand has set ablaze; move to the side before engaging. If Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab misses, do not step forward while it is on cooldown.
Brand.combo: After Brand W Pillar of Flame is used, pull Brand in with Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab. Activate Blitzcrank E Power Fist just before the grab lands to knock him up as soon as he arrives, then finish with Blitzcrank R Static Field. If the Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab angle is difficult, close in with Blitzcrank W Overdrive, knock him up first with Blitzcrank E Power Fist, then land Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab.
Brand.escape: Brand has no mobility ability, so the moment after Brand W Pillar of Flame is used is your chance to engage. If Brand P Blaze is on you, Brand Q Sear can stun you; wait for the fire to expire or dodge its projectile before approaching. When engaging with Blitzcrank W Overdrive, account for the self slow when its effect ends.
Brand.phase: Later in the game, pull Brand only when your allies can follow up immediately, rather than trying to kill him alone.
Brand.teamfight: Spread out from your allies to avoid the spread of Brand E Conflagration and the bounces of Brand R Pyroclasm, and do not stand beside an ally who is ablaze. If you see Brand cast Brand R Pyroclasm, split up early. From a position where your allies can attack immediately, pull a target with Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab, knock them up with Blitzcrank E Power Fist, then stay close and keep up the pressure.

Hwei.watch: If Hwei E Subject: Torment roots or pulls you, you are likely to take follow-up abilities too. If the first ability hits, reposition immediately to avoid the second ability and the explosion from Hwei P Signature of the Visionary. Also watch out for the slow from Hwei R Spiraling Despair and the maximum health damage from Hwei Q Subject: Disaster.
Hwei.build: Build magic resistance first against Hwei’s damage. Also consider tenacity and movement speed to reduce the risk of being caught by Hwei E Subject: Torment. Since Hwei Q Subject: Disaster deals damage based on maximum health, avoid building large amounts of health alone.
Hwei.fight: Engage right after Hwei E Subject: Torment is used to poke or clear the wave. Hwei has no mobility ability, so pull him in with Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab, knock him up with Blitzcrank E Power Fist, and attack with your allies. If one of Hwei’s abilities hits you in the first trade, reposition instead of staying there.
Hwei.laning: Control vision in the brush to hide Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab’s range, and look for the moment Hwei moves away from the minions. Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab is blocked by minions and costly to use early, so save it when the angle is uncertain. If Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab is on cooldown, don’t move forward; protect farming.
Hwei.combo: Activate Blitzcrank E Power Fist just before Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab lands, knock Hwei up as soon as he arrives, then finish with Blitzcrank R Static Field. If the grab angle is uncertain, wait until Hwei E Subject: Torment is used, approach from the brush with Blitzcrank W Overdrive, land Blitzcrank E Power Fist first, then use Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab.
Hwei.escape: Hwei has no mobility ability, so the moment after Hwei E Subject: Torment is used is your opening to engage. If Hwei E Subject: Torment is still available, it can push an approaching Blitzcrank back or root him. Take a wide path around ground effects or eyes placed in a passage.
Hwei.phase: Later in the game, Blitzcrank has trouble killing a target alone, so pull only when your allies can follow up.
Hwei.teamfight: Right after Hwei E Subject: Torment is used, pull Hwei with Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab from a position where your allies can attack immediately. Knock him up with Blitzcrank E Power Fist, silence him with Blitzcrank R Static Field, then stay close with Blitzcrank W Overdrive to maintain pressure. Approach by going around passages containing ground effects and eyes Hwei has placed.

Heimerdinger.build: Prioritize movement speed so you can leave telegraphed attack areas. Heimerdinger’s turrets, rockets, and grenade all deal magic damage, so build magic resistance over armor. If the stun at the grenade’s center is a concern, consider tenacity too.
Heimerdinger.fight: At that moment, pull him in with Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab and knock him up with Blitzcrank E Power Fist.
Heimerdinger.laning: Control vision in the brush to conceal Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab’s range, and look for a grab when Heimerdinger steps away from the minions. Do not step forward while Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab is on cooldown.
Heimerdinger.combo: Activate Blitzcrank E Power Fist just before Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab lands, knock the target up as soon as they arrive, then finish with Blitzcrank R Static Field.
Heimerdinger.escape: Even if you close in with Blitzcrank W Overdrive, it slows you when its duration ends, so do not fight for long inside turret range.
Heimerdinger.phase: Later in the game, Blitzcrank has trouble finishing a target alone, so attempt only grabs your allies can follow up on immediately.
Heimerdinger.teamfight: While Heimerdinger R UPGRADE!!! is ready, do not group with your allies at one spot in front of an objective or in a narrow passage. Instead of crossing the turret setup head-on, pull Heimerdinger himself from the side with Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab and knock him up with Blitzcrank E Power Fist. Grab only when your allies can follow up immediately; after engaging, stay close to the target with Blitzcrank E Power Fist and Blitzcrank W Overdrive to maintain pressure.

Janna.watch: Janna Q Howling Gale interrupts your engage with a knockup, so if you hear the whirlwind from a brush or outside vision, avoid its path. Janna R Monsoon pushes nearby enemies away, so be ready to interrupt it with the silence from Blitzcrank R Static Field as she uses it. Do not focus damage on a target shielded by Janna E Eye Of The Storm until the shield is gone.
Janna.build: Prioritize items that increase maximum mana if you want a stronger Blitzcrank P Mana Barrier. If you need resistance against Janna’s damage, build magic resistance over armor. Janna herself deals little damage, though, so there is rarely a need to build resistance just for her.
Janna.fight: After forcing Janna to use Janna E Eye Of The Storm, target someone whose shield has been removed or Janna when she is isolated. Janna has relatively low magic resistance, so Blitzcrank’s magic damage hits hard, but engage only when your allies can follow up. If landing Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab is difficult, wait until Janna’s crowd control is used, then approach from the brush with Blitzcrank W Overdrive and knock her up first with Blitzcrank E Power Fist.
Janna.laning: Control vision in the brush to conceal Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab’s range, and look for a moment when Janna steps away from the minions. Pressure the ally Janna is protecting to make her use Janna E Eye Of The Storm, then look for an engage if she wastes Janna Q Howling Gale and Janna W Zephyr. When Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab is unavailable, stay back and protect your ally’s farming.
Janna.combo: Activate Blitzcrank E Power Fist just before Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab lands, then immediately knock up the target you pull in. Follow with Blitzcrank R Static Field if you need to remove Janna E Eye Of The Storm or interrupt Janna R Monsoon. If there is no grab angle, close in with Blitzcrank W Overdrive, knock the target up with Blitzcrank E Power Fist, then land Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab.
Janna.escape: The moment after Janna wastes Janna Q Howling Gale and Janna W Zephyr is your chance to approach. Janna R Monsoon can push back your engage, so start the fight within range to interrupt it with Blitzcrank R Static Field at that moment.
Janna.phase: Later in the game, Blitzcrank has trouble killing a target alone, so avoid grabs your allies cannot follow up on.
Janna.teamfight: Establish vision and look for a moment when Janna is away from an allied damage dealer, or pick off Janna first. Janna R Monsoon can push back an engage, so time the silence from Blitzcrank R Static Field to interrupt it. If your grab lands, stay close to the target with Blitzcrank E Power Fist and Blitzcrank W Overdrive so your allies can keep attacking.

Karma.watch: If you dodge Karma Q Inner Flame harass, you can avoid helping reduce Karma R Mantra’s cooldown. If you’re hit by Karma Q Inner Flame empowered by Karma R Mantra, immediately leave the remaining area of effect. If Karma W Focused Resolve connects, create distance to break the tether before it roots you.
Karma.build: Build magic resistance first because Karma's main damage is magic. Get movement speed to help break Karma W Focused Resolve's link and leave the area of Karma Q Inner Flame. Consider items that increase maximum mana to strengthen Blitzcrank P Mana Barrier.
Karma.fight: Close the distance and fight after Karma W Focused Resolve is used. When Karma E Inspire's shield activates, wait to burst until it expires, then lock Karma down with Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab and Blitzcrank E Power Fist. If Karma W Focused Resolve empowered by Karma R Mantra links to you, move away to break it before the root.
Karma.laning: Control brush vision to conceal the range of Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab, and look for Karma when she moves away from minions. Avoid her poke by positioning behind minions or outside its range.
Karma.combo: Activate Blitzcrank E Power Fist just before Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab hits, knock Karma up as soon as she is pulled in, then finish with Blitzcrank R Static Field. If Karma W Focused Resolve is down and the grab angle is uncertain, use brush to approach with Blitzcrank W Overdrive, knock her up first with Blitzcrank E Power Fist, then land Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab.
Karma.escape: Karma W Focused Resolve being down is your chance to engage. If Karma has applied a shield with Karma E Inspire, wait for it to expire before going in. Blitzcrank has no ability to escape on his own, so do not force an approach before confirming this opening.
Karma.phase: Late game, you will struggle to kill a target alone, so pull one in only when allies can follow up.
Karma.teamfight: If you engage while Karma W Focused Resolve is available, she can catch Blitzcrank as he goes in. Engage after she uses it. If Karma E Inspire empowered by Karma R Mantra shields nearby allies, delay your burst until the shields expire. Pull a target with Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab when allies can attack immediately, then maintain pressure with Blitzcrank E Power Fist and Blitzcrank W Overdrive.

Lux.watch: Getting caught by Lux Q Light Binding makes you vulnerable to her follow-up abilities, so bait it out and approach after it misses. Do not stay in the area of Lux E Lucent Singularity. If an ability applies a Lux P Illumination mark to you, leave her basic attack range. Dodge sideways when you see the targeting line for Lux R Final Spark.
Lux.build: Get movement speed first so you can leave the area of Lux E Lucent Singularity. Build magic resistance against Lux's damage and tenacity to reduce the risk from Lux Q Light Binding.
Lux.fight: When Lux Q Light Binding misses, close the distance from brush or the side. Lux has no mobility ability, so once you reach her, you can knock her up with Blitzcrank E Power Fist and pull her with Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab. For a short trade, use Blitzcrank E Power Fist immediately after a basic attack to keep attacking.
Lux.laning: Control brush vision to conceal the range of Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab, and look for a grab when Lux moves away from minions. Lux Q Light Binding can pass through the first ally and bind two targets, so avoid standing in a straight line with an ally. While Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab is on cooldown, do not step forward; back off to safeguard farming.
Lux.combo: When Lux Q Light Binding misses, pull her with Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab. Activate Blitzcrank E Power Fist just before the grab lands to knock her up as soon as she arrives. Use Blitzcrank R Static Field when you need to finish her immediately or remove Lux W Prismatic Barrier's shield. If a grab angle is difficult, wait until Lux Q Light Binding is down, approach from brush with Blitzcrank W Overdrive, knock her up first with Blitzcrank E Power Fist, then land Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab.
Lux.escape: The moment after you dodge Lux Q Light Binding is your chance to engage. Lux has no mobility ability, so once you close the distance, she is easy to catch with Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab and Blitzcrank E Power Fist.
Lux.phase: Late game, Blitzcrank will struggle to kill a target alone, so grab only when allies can follow up.
Lux.teamfight: Do not group with allies and approach from one direction, or Lux E Lucent Singularity can block you together. Pull Lux with Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab when allies can attack her immediately, then knock her up with Blitzcrank E Power Fist. After engaging, stay on her with Blitzcrank W Overdrive to maintain pressure.

Leona.watch: If Leona E Zenith Blade hits you, she can follow with Leona Q Shield of Daybreak and Leona R Solar Flare, so do not let her get close enough. When Leona activates Leona W Eclipse, leave its area before it explodes. When the indicator for Leona R Solar Flare appears, move sideways to avoid the stun at its center.
Leona.build: Because Blitzcrank has no mobility ability, consider tenacity first against Leona's chain of crowd control. Magic resistance helps against Leona's own damage, but choose resistance based on the damage type of the opposing carry who attacks while she holds you down. Items that increase maximum mana strengthen Blitzcrank P Mana Barrier.
Leona.fight: Early on, do not initiate physical damage trades against Leona's high armor. If allies can follow up immediately after Leona E Zenith Blade is used, counterattack with Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab and Blitzcrank E Power Fist.
Leona.laning: Avoid standing in a straight line with your marksman to reduce the chance of Leona E Zenith Blade reaching the farther target. Control brush vision to conceal the range of Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab, and look for a moment when minions will not block it. Do not step forward while Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab is on cooldown.
Leona.combo: After Leona E Zenith Blade is used, pull her with Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab, knock her up with Blitzcrank E Power Fist, then finish with Blitzcrank R Static Field. Activate Blitzcrank E Power Fist just before Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab hits to knock her up as soon as she is pulled in.
Leona.escape: Right after you draw out Leona E Zenith Blade is Blitzcrank's opening to engage. Once you confirm Leona's crowd control is down, close the distance with Blitzcrank W Overdrive, knock her up first with Blitzcrank E Power Fist, then land Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab.
Leona.phase: Late game, you will struggle to kill a target alone, so look only for openings allies can follow up on.
Leona.teamfight: Use Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab only on targets allies can attack immediately. After the catch, keep up the pressure with Blitzcrank E Power Fist and Blitzcrank W Overdrive. If Leona P Sunlight marks you, back away instead of stepping forward because the enemy can follow up with an attack.

Lulu.watch: Lulu W Whimsy silences Blitzcrank and prevents him from chaining abilities, so do not force an approach while it is available. Lulu R Wild Growth increases a target's health and knocks up nearby enemies, so do not engage assuming a target she can use it on is a guaranteed kill.
Lulu.build: Consider items that increase maximum mana first to strengthen Blitzcrank P Mana Barrier. Lulu deals magic damage, but her damage is low, so choose resistance based on the damage type of the target she protects.
Lulu.laning: Stay behind minions to reduce the bonus damage from Lulu P Pix, Faerie Companion, and control brush vision to conceal the range of Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab. Minions block Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab, so look for Lulu when she moves away from them. Do not step forward while Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab is down.
Lulu.combo: When you have an opening to catch Lulu, activate Blitzcrank E Power Fist just before Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab hits. Knock her up as soon as she is pulled in, then follow with Blitzcrank R Static Field if you need immediate damage or a silence, or need to remove a shield.
Lulu.escape: Lulu has no dash to escape on her own, so the moment after she uses Lulu W Whimsy on another ally is an opening to engage. If Lulu R Wild Growth is also down, look for a moment when she cannot stop your engage with its knockup or save the target, then chain Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab and Blitzcrank E Power Fist.
Lulu.phase: Late game, you will struggle to secure a kill alone, so pull a target in only when allies can follow up.
Lulu.teamfight: If Lulu R Wild Growth is available, look for Lulu herself or another target instead of using Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab on someone she can save. Pull a target when allies can follow up immediately. After a successful pull, stay on the target and apply pressure with Blitzcrank E Power Fist and Blitzcrank W Overdrive.
Lulu.fight: Hold off on engaging until Lulu W Whimsy is used. For a short trade, use Blitzcrank E Power Fist immediately after a basic attack. Target Lulu herself when her shield and Lulu P Pix, Faerie Companion are on an ally and your allies can follow up.

Maokai.watch: When Maokai W Twisted Advance catches you, you’re likely to get hit by follow-up attacks after the root, so stay out of range near bushes while it’s ready. Maokai E Sapling Toss explodes in a larger area from bushes, so approach carefully; if a sapling follows you, lead it toward minions or monsters instead of your allies. Maokai R Nature's Grasp roots for longer at a distance, so dodge perpendicular to its path.
Maokai.build: Prioritize movement speed to walk out of telegraphed areas. Magic resistance helps against Maokai's damage, but choose your defenses based on the enemy damage dealer who attacks while Maokai holds you. Consider tenacity against the roots from Maokai W Twisted Advance and Maokai R Nature's Grasp.
Maokai.fight: Right after you draw out Maokai W Twisted Advance is your chance to close in and fight. Focus ability poke on the enemy damage dealer so you do not make the healing from Maokai P Sap Magic available more frequently.
Maokai.laning: Secure brush vision to conceal the range of Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab, but stay out of brush planted with Maokai E Sapling Toss. Minions block Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab, so look for an angle when Maokai moves away from them. Back off while Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab is on cooldown, and step forward to pressure when Maokai W Twisted Advance is down.
Maokai.combo: When Maokai W Twisted Advance is down and your allies can follow up, pull him with Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab. Activate Blitzcrank E Power Fist just before the grab lands to knock him up as soon as he arrives, then use Blitzcrank R Static Field if you need an immediate finish or silence. If an angle for Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab is difficult, wait until the enemy's crowd control is down, approach with Blitzcrank W Overdrive, knock them up first with Blitzcrank E Power Fist, then follow with Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab.
Maokai.escape: Go in right after Maokai W Twisted Advance is used. If Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab and Blitzcrank E Power Fist land then, Maokai has a hard time escaping. Blitzcrank has no ability to escape on his own, so keep your distance while Maokai W Twisted Advance and Maokai R Nature's Grasp are ready.
Maokai.phase: Later in the game, Blitzcrank struggles to kill a target alone, so only attempt grabs your allies can follow up on.
Maokai.teamfight: Use Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab on a target your allies can attack immediately, then knock them up with Blitzcrank E Power Fist to keep up the pressure. If Maokai R Nature's Grasp comes from afar, fight in open terrain with room to dodge sideways. Target the enemy damage dealer instead of repeatedly hitting Maokai with abilities and speeding up the healing from Maokai P Sap Magic.

Milio.watch: Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick knocks back the first enemy it hits, so check whether he has used it before closing in on him. While Milio W Cozy Campfire is active and extends the enemy marksman's range, delay fights at the front line.
Milio.build: Once Milio's healing starts affecting fights, get healing reduction sooner. Milio deals magic damage, but his own damage is low, so choose defensive stats based on the enemy damage dealer's damage type.
Milio.fight: When Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick is down, approach around brush and target Milio himself. You can also close in with Blitzcrank W Overdrive, knock him up first with Blitzcrank E Power Fist, then land Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab.
Milio.laning: Look for a moment when Milio is away from minions. While Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab is on cooldown, back off to safeguard farming. Early on, pressure Milio's mana through attrition and wave control.
Milio.combo: Activate Blitzcrank E Power Fist just before Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab lands, knock the target up as soon as they arrive, then finish with Blitzcrank R Static Field. Milio R Breath of Life cannot remove a knockup, so following up with Blitzcrank E Power Fist remains effective. Use Blitzcrank R Static Field when you need to remove the shield from Milio E Warm Hugs, too.
Milio.escape: After Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick is used, you have a chance to approach. Close the distance with Blitzcrank W Overdrive and knock him up with Blitzcrank E Power Fist, or pull him with Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab from an angle that minions cannot block.
Milio.phase: Later in the game, you will struggle to kill a target alone, so only pull when your allies can follow up immediately.
Milio.teamfight: If your allies can follow up immediately and Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick is down, target Milio himself first: he has low defensive stats and no mobility ability. Pull him with Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab and knock him up with Blitzcrank E Power Fist; Milio R Breath of Life cannot remove the knockup. After engaging, stay on the target with Blitzcrank E Power Fist and Blitzcrank W Overdrive to maintain pressure.

Morgana.watch: If Morgana Q Dark Binding hits you, Morgana W Tormented Shadow and follow-up attacks can land, so keep minions between you and her. When low on health, do not retreat through Morgana W Tormented Shadow. If Morgana R Soul Shackles links to you, leave its range before the stun triggers.
Morgana.build: Build magic resistance first against Morgana's magic damage. If Morgana Q Dark Binding and Morgana R Soul Shackles make it hard to escape, consider tenacity first. If fights run long, get healing reduction against Morgana P Soul Siphon and Morgana W Tormented Shadow.
Morgana.fight: After Morgana E Black Shield is used, engage with Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab or Blitzcrank E Power Fist. Keep an approach angle that lets you dodge Morgana Q Dark Binding. Blitzcrank's magic damage is effective against Morgana, but he has no way to escape on his own once caught, so avoid overcommitting to damage trades.
Morgana.laning: Secure brush vision to conceal the range of Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab, and keep minions between you and Morgana to avoid Morgana Q Dark Binding. Look to use Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab when Morgana moves away from minions; hold it on uncertain angles to maintain pressure. While Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab is on cooldown, do not step forward; back off to safeguard farming.
Morgana.combo: If Morgana E Black Shield is down, pull her with Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab. Activate Blitzcrank E Power Fist just before the grab lands, knock her up as soon as she arrives, then finish with Blitzcrank R Static Field. If Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab is hard to land, confirm Morgana's crowd control is down, approach around brush with Blitzcrank W Overdrive, knock her up first with Blitzcrank E Power Fist, then land Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab.
Morgana.escape: Engage while Morgana Q Dark Binding is down and no shield from Morgana E Black Shield is present. Morgana has no ability to create distance on her own, so close in and catch her with Blitzcrank E Power Fist or Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab. If Morgana R Soul Shackles links to you, try to leave its range with Blitzcrank W Overdrive before the stun.
Morgana.phase: Later in the game, you will struggle to kill a target alone, so only grab when your allies can follow up.
Morgana.teamfight: When Morgana E Black Shield is down, pull a target your allies can follow up on immediately with Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab. After engaging, stay on the target with Blitzcrank E Power Fist and Blitzcrank W Overdrive to maintain pressure. If Morgana R Soul Shackles links to you, leave its range before the stun triggers.

Nautilus.watch: Nautilus Q Dredge Line starts his engage, so keep minions between you and him to avoid it. The first basic attack from Nautilus P Staggering Blow roots you and makes follow-up abilities easier to land, so do not linger within his basic attack range. When Nautilus R Depth Charge is available, do not line up with allies along its path.
Nautilus.build: If you often die while locked down by crowd control, get tenacity first. Build magic resistance against damage from Nautilus Q Dredge Line, Nautilus W Titan's Wrath, and Nautilus E Riptide. Increasing your maximum mana afterward also strengthens Blitzcrank P Mana Barrier.
Nautilus.fight: Right after Nautilus Q Dredge Line misses is your chance to trade damage and engage. Watch your spacing to avoid Nautilus P Staggering Blow. If Nautilus uses Nautilus E Riptide while close to you, move before the waves finish so you do not walk into the later explosions. If Nautilus W Titan's Wrath is active, wear down the shield first when you have room to do so.
Nautilus.laning: Keep minions between you and Nautilus to block Nautilus Q Dredge Line, and secure brush vision to conceal the range of Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab. Minions block Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab, and early on its mana cost and cooldown are significant, so wait for a clear angle. After using Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab, back off and protect farming instead of stepping forward.
Nautilus.combo: If Nautilus Q Dredge Line is down, pull him with Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab, knock him up with Blitzcrank E Power Fist, then finish with Blitzcrank R Static Field. Activate Blitzcrank E Power Fist just before Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab lands to knock him up the moment he arrives. If you can catch him within your allied turret's range, the turret will attack him too.
Nautilus.escape: Go in right after Nautilus Q Dredge Line is used. If Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab and Blitzcrank E Power Fist land then, Nautilus has a hard time escaping. If Blitzcrank is caught instead, he has no ability to escape on his own, so keep your distance while Nautilus still has crowd control available.
Nautilus.phase: Later in the game, Blitzcrank struggles to kill a target alone, so only attempt grabs your allies can follow up on.
Nautilus.teamfight: Do not line up with allies along the path of Nautilus R Depth Charge. Pull a target your allies can follow up on immediately with Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab, then knock them up with Blitzcrank E Power Fist. After engaging, stay on the target with Blitzcrank E Power Fist and Blitzcrank W Overdrive to keep up the pressure.

Neeko.watch: Neeko E Tangle-Barbs grows larger and faster after hitting something, making it easier to root someone behind it. Avoid standing in line with an ally. Neeko R Pop Blossom's windup may be hidden while Neeko is disguised, so spread out as soon as a suspicious enemy gets close.
Neeko.build: Build magic resistance first against the magic damage from Neeko Q Blooming Burst, Neeko W Shapesplitter, and Neeko E Tangle-Barbs. Get movement speed to walk out of telegraphed areas. Prioritize tenacity if getting rooted by Neeko E Tangle-Barbs and then hit by Neeko R Pop Blossom would kill you.
Neeko.fight: Right after Neeko E Tangle-Barbs is used, you can approach with Blitzcrank W Overdrive and knock her up with Blitzcrank E Power Fist to force a trade. Blitzcrank has no escape ability, so manage your distance while Neeko's root and ultimate are available.
Neeko.laning: Control brush vision to conceal the range of Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab, and pull Neeko when she is clear of minions. Minions block Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab, and its early mana cost and cooldown are punishing, so save it when the angle is uncertain. After using it, back off instead of stepping forward and protect farming.
Neeko.combo: If you have an angle to pull Neeko, activate Blitzcrank E Power Fist just before Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab hits. Knock her up as soon as she arrives, then finish with Blitzcrank R Static Field. If a grab is difficult, wait until Neeko E Tangle-Barbs is used, approach from brush with Blitzcrank W Overdrive, knock her up first with Blitzcrank E Power Fist, then land Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab.
Neeko.escape: Right after Neeko E Tangle-Barbs is used is your chance to approach.
Neeko.phase: Keep up the pressure in the early and mid game, but in the late game, pull only when your allies can follow up.
Neeko.teamfight: A nearby enemy may be Neeko disguised with Neeko P Inherent Glamour, so watch for suspicious positioning and do not chase the clone from Neeko W Shapesplitter. If you see the windup for Neeko R Pop Blossom, leave its area; if you suspect a disguised Neeko, spread out before she gets close. When your allies can follow up immediately, pull the real Neeko with Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab, knock her up with Blitzcrank E Power Fist, and keep up the pressure.

Pantheon.watch: Pantheon W Shield Vault targets and stuns you, so stay out of its range. Keep minions between you and Pantheon when he pokes with Pantheon Q Comet Spear. While Pantheon E Aegis Assault blocks damage from the front, wait to attack or move to his side.
Pantheon.build: Build armor first against Pantheon's main damage. Pantheon W Shield Vault deals damage based on maximum health, so avoid building only health. Items that increase maximum mana can strengthen Blitzcrank P Mana Barrier.
Pantheon.fight: Avoid trading blows during Pantheon's strong early game, and engage after Pantheon W Shield Vault is used. Do not attack Pantheon E Aegis Assault from the front; wait for it to end or attack from the side.
Pantheon.laning: Early on, save Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab when the angle is uncertain and control brush vision to apply pressure. Stand behind minions against Pantheon Q Comet Spear poke, but wait for an angle clear of minions before using Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab. Do not step forward while Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab is on cooldown.
Pantheon.combo: Pull Pantheon with Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab when Pantheon E Aegis Assault ends or you have an angle from the side. Activate Blitzcrank E Power Fist just before the grab hits to knock him up immediately, then follow with Blitzcrank R Static Field if you need immediate burst damage or a silence.
Pantheon.phase: Pantheon's impact falls off in the late game, but Blitzcrank also struggles to kill a target alone, so make sure your allies can follow up.
Pantheon.teamfight: Use Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab on a target your allies can follow up on immediately, knock them up with Blitzcrank E Power Fist, then stay close and apply pressure. While Pantheon E Aegis Assault blocks damage from the front, move to his side or wait for it to end. If you see the landing indicator for Pantheon R Grand Starfall, walk out of its area.

Nami.watch: Nami Q Aqua Prison stuns but falls slowly, so walk sideways when you see its indicator. Nami R Tidal Wave travels far but slowly; sidestep as soon as you see it and watch for a follow-up Nami Q Aqua Prison. Do not fight an enemy affected by Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing head-on. Re-engage after it expires.
Nami.build: Get movement speed first so you can walk out of the telegraphed areas of Nami Q Aqua Prison and Nami R Tidal Wave. Build magic resistance rather than armor against Nami's damage. If the healing from Nami W Ebb and Flow is a problem, consider Morellonomicon for healing reduction.
Nami.fight: Right after Nami Q Aqua Prison misses is your chance to engage. Conceal your distance from brush, then target Nami with Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab and knock her up with Blitzcrank E Power Fist. If landing Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab is difficult, wait until Nami's crowd control is used, approach with Blitzcrank W Overdrive, and use Blitzcrank E Power Fist first.
Nami.laning: Control brush vision to conceal the range of Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab, and look for an angle when Nami is clear of minions. If Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab is used, back off instead of stepping forward to safeguard farming.
Nami.combo: Activate Blitzcrank E Power Fist just before Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab hits, then immediately knock up Nami when she arrives. Follow with Blitzcrank R Static Field if you need to finish her immediately or silence her. If you have no angle for Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab and Nami's crowd control is used, approach with Blitzcrank W Overdrive, knock her up with Blitzcrank E Power Fist, then land Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab.
Nami.escape: Nami has no mobility ability to create distance, so use the moment right after Nami Q Aqua Prison misses as your opening. If you see Nami R Tidal Wave, sidestep it and check for a follow-up Nami Q Aqua Prison before going in. Do not immediately engage an enemy affected by Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing; wait for it to expire.
Nami.phase: In the late game, Blitzcrank struggles to kill a target alone, so attempt grabs only when your allies can follow up.
Nami.teamfight: When your allies can follow up immediately, pull Nami with Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab and knock her up with Blitzcrank E Power Fist. After a successful engage, stay on your target and maintain pressure with Blitzcrank E Power Fist and Blitzcrank W Overdrive. If you see Nami R Tidal Wave, sidestep it to avoid getting caught by a follow-up Nami Q Aqua Prison.

Pyke.watch: Keep your distance: if Pyke Q Bone Skewer pulls or slows Blitzcrank, he has no escape ability and can easily take follow-up attacks. When Pyke E Phantom Undertow starts, move sideways out of its dash path to avoid the stun. If you see a shark shadow beneath your feet, Pyke W Ghostwater Dive has brought him close, so retreat toward allies or your turret.
Pyke.build: Pyke's main damage is physical, and his passive heals him, so build Thornmail for armor and healing reduction. Prioritize armor and health over magic resistance, and get enough health to stay above the threshold for Pyke R Death From Below.
Pyke.fight: After sidestepping the stun from Pyke E Phantom Undertow, counterattack where Pyke ends up with Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab and Blitzcrank E Power Fist. If Pyke retreats after the trade, maintain vision of him to prevent the healing from Pyke P Gift of the Drowned Ones. Avoid engaging first with Blitzcrank W Overdrive while Pyke's crowd control is available.
Pyke.laning: Control brush vision to conceal the range of Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab, and look for a grab only when Pyke is clear of minions. Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab has a punishing early mana cost and cooldown, so save it when the angle is uncertain. While Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab is on cooldown, back off instead of stepping forward and protect farming.
Pyke.combo: Activate Blitzcrank E Power Fist just before Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab hits, immediately knock up Pyke when he arrives, then finish with Blitzcrank R Static Field. If a grab is difficult, wait until Pyke's crowd control is used, approach through brush with Blitzcrank W Overdrive, knock him up first with Blitzcrank E Power Fist, then land Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab.
Pyke.escape: Dodging Pyke E Phantom Undertow creates an opening while one of Pyke's tools for engaging and escaping is unavailable. Even then, do not immediately commit too far if Pyke R Death From Below is available. Before Pyke R Death From Below is available again, especially when Pyke E Phantom Undertow is also used, catch him with Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab and Blitzcrank E Power Fist.
Pyke.phase: In the late game, Blitzcrank struggles to kill a target alone, so grab only when your allies can follow up immediately.
Pyke.teamfight: When your allies can attack immediately afterward, pull Pyke with Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab and knock him up with Blitzcrank E Power Fist to hold him in place. Do not stand next to a low-health ally, so you are not both caught in the area of Pyke R Death From Below. Have injured allies spread out to prevent Pyke from chaining executions.

Rakan.watch: Rakan W Grand Entrance shows its landing spot in advance, so sidestep the knock-up when he starts the dash. When Rakan R The Quickness is active, knock him up with Blitzcrank E Power Fist before he touches you, or keep terrain between you. Do not line up with allies, or several of you may be charmed.
Rakan.build: Rakan's main threat is an engage with Rakan W Grand Entrance and Rakan R The Quickness, so get a way to cleanse crowd control first. If building resistance, choose magic resistance against his damage.
Rakan.fight: Trade right after the shield from Rakan P Fey Feathers is stripped away. Dodge or bait Rakan W Grand Entrance, then close in and catch him with Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab and Blitzcrank E Power Fist. Blitzcrank has no escape ability, so do not overcommit while Rakan still has crowd control available.
Rakan.laning: Control vision in the brush to conceal the range of Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab, and look for an angle when Rakan is away from minions. If Rakan is securing vision or moving alone, away from his allies, he has no ally to escape to with Rakan E Battle Dance. That is your chance to catch him.
Rakan.combo: Activate Blitzcrank E Power Fist just before Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab hits. Knock Rakan up as soon as he is pulled in, then finish with Blitzcrank R Static Field. Use this sequence when Rakan W Grand Entrance is down or Rakan is away from his allies. If a grab angle is hard to find, wait until Rakan's crowd control is down, close in with Blitzcrank W Overdrive, knock him up first with Blitzcrank E Power Fist, then land Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab.
Rakan.escape: Bait Rakan W Grand Entrance and dodge the landing; the moment after is your opening. If Rakan is away from his allies, he has no target to escape to with Rakan E Battle Dance, so catch him with Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab or Blitzcrank E Power Fist.
Rakan.phase: Later in the game, Blitzcrank struggles to secure a kill alone, so pull someone in only when allies can follow up.
Rakan.teamfight: Do not line up with allies and let Rakan R The Quickness charm several of you. When Rakan engages, knock him up with Blitzcrank E Power Fist to stop his movement, then use Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab on a target your allies can immediately follow up on. After a successful grab, stay on the target with Blitzcrank E Power Fist and Blitzcrank W Overdrive to keep up the pressure.

Rell.build: Consider tenacity first, since crowd control makes escape difficult, and build magic resistance. Rell P Break the Mold lowers resistances, and Rell E Full Tilt deals damage based on maximum health, so be cautious about stacking health alone. More maximum mana strengthens Blitzcrank P Mana Barrier, but Rell Q Shattering Strike can break it.
Rell.fight: Stay outside the range of Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down and look for the moment right after she uses it when she becomes separated and is left alone. Rell has low magic resistance and no way to heal, so chip away at her health with allies from outside her engage range. Before Rell E Full Tilt comes back up, look for a chance to catch her with Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab and Blitzcrank E Power Fist.
Rell.laning: Control vision in the brush to conceal the range of Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab, and throw it when Rell is away from minions. Hold Q on uncertain angles to maintain pressure, and do not step forward while it is on cooldown. If Rell and an ally rush in with Rell E Full Tilt, stop trading and retreat beyond the range of Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down.
Rell.combo: Before Rell E Full Tilt comes back up, activate Blitzcrank E Power Fist just before Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab hits. Knock her up as soon as she is pulled in, then finish with Blitzcrank R Static Field. Use R when you need to remove Rell's shield, too. Look for this sequence where allies can follow up immediately.
Rell.escape: When Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down is down, create distance first, then engage in the window when Rell E Full Tilt is also down or has not come back up. If only one movement ability is down, she can escape with the other, so do not rush Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab. When approaching with Blitzcrank W Overdrive, account for the slow it applies to you afterward.
Rell.phase: Later in the game, Blitzcrank struggles to kill a target alone, so avoid grabs without allied follow-up.
Rell.teamfight: Spread out from allies before engaging so Rell R Magnet Storm cannot pull you in together. Use Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab on a target allies can attack immediately, then knock them up with Blitzcrank E Power Fist after the pull. After engaging, stay on the target with Blitzcrank E Power Fist and Blitzcrank W Overdrive to help allies land their attacks.

Senna.watch: Senna Q Piercing Darkness harasses and heals in a straight line through allies or minions, so move off the line connecting Senna to that target. Dodge Senna W Last Embrace from behind minions; if it hits, move away from allies before the root triggers. After Senna hits you once, back off before she can hit you a second time and collect mist.
Senna.build: Build armor first against Senna's main damage. Account for her healing by getting armor and healing reduction from Thornmail, and take hits in front of allies. Build armor alongside health rather than stacking health alone.
Senna.fight: Approach through brush when Senna W Last Embrace is down. Senna has no ability to create distance on her own, so once you close in, you can knock her up with Blitzcrank E Power Fist and follow with Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab to catch her. If one poke attack hits you, back off before she lands a second.
Senna.laning: Control vision in the brush to conceal the range of Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab, and look for a moment when Senna is away from minions. When a soul appears, watch where Senna will step forward and wait for a chance to disrupt her collection. If Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab misses, do not step forward; fall back and protect farming.
Senna.combo: Activate Blitzcrank E Power Fist just before pulling Senna with Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab so you knock her up as soon as she arrives. Follow with Blitzcrank R Static Field to finish. If a grab angle is hard to find and Senna W Last Embrace is down, close in with Blitzcrank W Overdrive, knock her up first with Blitzcrank E Power Fist, then land Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab.
Senna.escape: Senna W Last Embrace being down is your chance to approach. Senna has no ability to create distance on her own, so close in with Blitzcrank W Overdrive, then follow Blitzcrank E Power Fist with Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab. If Senna E Curse of the Black Mist spreads mist, do not hold your ground there; retreat to a place with vision.
Senna.phase: Later in the game, Senna gains range and attack damage, so pull her in only when allies can follow up immediately.
Senna.teamfight: When you see Senna E Curse of the Black Mist, back off to regain vision or use an area ability such as Blitzcrank R Static Field to stop the engage. Use Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab only on a target allies can attack immediately, then knock them up with Blitzcrank E Power Fist after the pull. Stay on the target with Blitzcrank W Overdrive to keep up the pressure.

Seraphine.watch: Seraphine E Beat Drop roots slowed targets and stuns immobilized targets. If you are slowed, first move out of the straight line in front of Seraphine. Seraphine R Encore extends its range each time it hits an allied champion, so do not line up with allies.
Seraphine.build: Seraphine's main damage is magic damage, so build magic resistance first. Increasing maximum mana also strengthens Blitzcrank P Mana Barrier.
Seraphine.fight: The moment after Seraphine E Beat Drop misses is your chance to engage. When Seraphine is alone, away from her marksman, close in with Blitzcrank W Overdrive, knock her up first with Blitzcrank E Power Fist, then look to land Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab. Use Blitzcrank R Static Field if you need to remove the shield from Seraphine W Surround Sound.
Seraphine.laning: Control vision in the brush to conceal the range of Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab, and look for a moment when Seraphine is away from minions. Minions block Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab, and its mana cost and cooldown are burdensome early, so save it on uncertain angles. If the ability is down, do not step forward; fall back and protect farming.
Seraphine.combo: When Seraphine E Beat Drop is down and you have a grab angle, pull her in with Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab, then knock her up with Blitzcrank E Power Fist. Activate Blitzcrank E Power Fist just before the grab hits so you can attack as soon as she arrives. Follow with Blitzcrank R Static Field to finish her immediately or remove the shield from Seraphine W Surround Sound.
Seraphine.escape: Engage right after Seraphine E Beat Drop is down. Seraphine has no mobility ability, so she will struggle to escape if you catch her with Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab or Blitzcrank E Power Fist. If the slow from Seraphine E Beat Drop hits you, prioritize moving out of its line over engaging.
Seraphine.phase: Later in the game, Blitzcrank struggles to kill a target alone, so pull someone in only when allies can follow up.
Seraphine.teamfight: Spread out to either side of your allies so Seraphine R Encore cannot extend through them to reach the backline. When allies can follow up immediately, pull Seraphine in with Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab and knock her up with Blitzcrank E Power Fist. Then stay on the target with Blitzcrank E Power Fist and Blitzcrank W Overdrive to help allies follow up.

Renata.watch: If Renata Glasc Q Handshake hits you, you are rooted and may then be thrown, potentially stunning an ally too. Dodge from behind minions or your frontline. While Renata Glasc R Hostile Takeover is available, keep space between you and your allies. If it hits you, use a crowd control cleanse or move away from them. Sidestep Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program to avoid its damage and slow while disrupting the shield's angle. Right after taking down an enemy affected by Renata Glasc W Bailout, retreat with your allies so that enemy cannot participate in a takedown.
Renata.build: First consider a crowd control cleanse such as Quicksilver Sash for Renata Glasc Q Handshake and Renata Glasc R Hostile Takeover. If you need to withstand damage, build magic resistance over armor. Because Renata Glasc P Leverage scales with maximum health, be wary of stacking health alone. Movement speed also helps you leave telegraphed areas.
Renata.fight: Once Renata Glasc Q Handshake is down, look for a Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab angle from a bush, or close in with Blitzcrank W Overdrive and land Blitzcrank E Power Fist first. Renata Glasc has no mobility ability, so after closing the gap, you can follow up with Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab and E Power Fist. Landing them in succession on the fragile Renata Glasc gives her less time to retaliate, and Blitzcrank's primary magic damage is effective against her.
Renata.laning: Control bush vision and wait for Renata Glasc to move away from minions. If Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab is down, do not step forward.
Renata.combo: If you have an angle to pull Renata Glasc, activate Blitzcrank E Power Fist just before Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab lands. Knock her up as soon as she arrives, then finish with Blitzcrank R Static Field. If the grab angle is uncertain and Renata Glasc Q Handshake is down, approach from a bush with Blitzcrank W Overdrive, knock her up with Blitzcrank E Power Fist first, then land Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab. If you can pull her into turret range, turret shots add damage.
Renata.escape: Renata Glasc has no mobility ability, so the window to close the gap comes after Renata Glasc Q Handshake is down. If Renata Glasc R Hostile Takeover is also down, you and your allies have less risk of losing control when you engage. When approaching with Blitzcrank W Overdrive, account for the self-slow after it ends.
Renata.phase: Late game, Blitzcrank struggles to finish a target alone. Pull only when your allies can follow up immediately.
Renata.teamfight: If Renata Glasc R Hostile Takeover is available, do not engage lined up with your allies. From a position where they can follow up immediately, pull Renata Glasc with Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab and knock her up with Blitzcrank E Power Fist to set up focused damage. After engaging, stay on the target and keep up pressure with Blitzcrank E Power Fist and W Overdrive. If you take down an enemy affected by Renata Glasc W Bailout, retreat so a nearby ally does not die.

Sona.watch: Sona R Crescendo stuns multiple targets in a line, so do not line up with your allies. Watch for it when Sona steps forward. If she moves into auto-attack range with Sona P Power Chord seemingly ready, back away before she slows you.
Sona.build: Build magic resistance first against Sona's main damage. Items that increase maximum mana strengthen Blitzcrank P Mana Barrier.
Sona.fight: When Sona steps forward to deliver an aura, catch her first with Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab or E Power Fist and force a trade. Repeated healing with Sona W Aria of Perseverance strains her mana, so pressure her from early on.
Sona.laning: Control bush vision to conceal the range of Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab, and look for the moment Sona moves away from minions. Hold Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab on uncertain angles to maintain pressure. If it is down, do not step forward.
Sona.combo: Pull Sona with Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab, knock her up with Blitzcrank E Power Fist, then finish with Blitzcrank R Static Field. Activate Blitzcrank E Power Fist just before Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab lands to knock her up as soon as she arrives. If the grab angle is difficult and Sona R Crescendo is down, approach from a bush with Blitzcrank W Overdrive, knock her up with Blitzcrank E Power Fist first, then land Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab.
Sona.escape: The window after Sona R Crescendo is down is a good time to approach. Catch her first with Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab or E Power Fist before she creates distance with Sona E Song of Celerity.
Sona.phase: Early game, before Sona P Power Chord has scaled up, is the best time to pressure her. Sona grows stronger later, while Blitzcrank struggles to kill a target alone, so grab only when allies can follow up.
Sona.teamfight: Spread out horizontally with your allies so Sona R Crescendo cannot stun you together. Pull from an angle where your allies can attack immediately, then knock the target up with Blitzcrank E Power Fist and stay close to apply pressure.

Swain.watch: Swain E Nevermove travels out and returns, so even after dodging the first wave, stay out of its path until it disappears completely. Swain Q Death's Hand deals more damage up close, so keep your distance before engaging. When Swain R Demonic Ascension is active, he drains nearby enemies and heals, so do not fight beside him for long.
Swain.build: Build magic resistance first against damage from Swain Q Death's Hand, W Vision of Empire, and E Nevermove. When fights drag on or the game enters its late stages, get healing reduction against the healing from Swain P Ravenous Flock and R Demonic Ascension.
Swain.fight: Engage right after Swain E Nevermove is down. Before approaching, keep your distance so Swain Q Death's Hand does not hit you up close. On the way in, catch him with Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab and E Power Fist to set up your allies' attacks.
Swain.laning: Early on, control bush vision to conceal the range of Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab, and look for the moment Swain moves away from minions. Do not waste Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab on an uncertain angle; use the pressure of holding it. While it is on cooldown, do not step forward. Fall back and protect farming.
Swain.combo: If Swain E Nevermove is down and your allies can follow up, pull him with Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab. Activate Blitzcrank E Power Fist just before Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab lands to knock him up as soon as he arrives, then finish with Blitzcrank R Static Field. If the grab angle is difficult, approach from a bush with Blitzcrank W Overdrive, knock him up with Blitzcrank E Power Fist first, then land Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab.
Swain.escape: Swain has no escape ability, so right after Swain E Nevermove is down is Blitzcrank's chance to engage. Confirm that you have dodged its returning wave, then approach with Blitzcrank W Overdrive and catch him with Blitzcrank E Power Fist or Q Rocket Grab.
Swain.phase: Early game, before Swain P Ravenous Flock has built up scaling stacks, is Blitzcrank's window to apply pressure. Swain becomes tougher over time, and Blitzcrank struggles to take down a target alone, so late game, look only for angles with allied follow-up.
Swain.teamfight: If Swain R Demonic Ascension is active, move out of range, wait for it to end, then re-engage. Have healing reduction when you engage, and use Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab on a target your allies can attack immediately. After the pull, stay on the target and maintain pressure with Blitzcrank E Power Fist and W Overdrive.

Soraka.watch: Watch for the silence and root inside Soraka E Equinox; use your engage ability before stepping into its area. Dodge Soraka Q Starcall to deny her healing and movement speed increase and keep up pressure. Soraka R Wish heals allies without a range limit, so account for whether it is available when looking for a kill.
Soraka.build: Build magic resistance first against Soraka's damage. If her healing prolongs fights, consider healing reduction next. Increasing maximum mana also strengthens Blitzcrank P Mana Barrier.
Soraka.fight: When Soraka E Equinox is down, pull Soraka with Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab and deal a quick burst of damage. Dodge Soraka Q Starcall while pressuring the allied marksman to force Soraka W Astral Infusion; this also reduces Soraka's own health.
Soraka.laning: Control bush vision to conceal the range of Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab, and throw it when Soraka moves away from minions. Early on, it costs a lot of mana and has a long cooldown, so save it on uncertain angles. If it is down, do not step forward. Fall back and protect farming.
Soraka.combo: Activate Blitzcrank E Power Fist just before Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab hits Soraka. Knock her up as soon as she arrives, then finish with Blitzcrank R Static Field. If Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab is hard to land, wait until Soraka E Equinox is down, approach from a bush with Blitzcrank W Overdrive, knock her up with Blitzcrank E Power Fist first, then land Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab.
Soraka.escape: Right after Soraka E Equinox is used to poke or clear the wave is your chance to engage. Soraka has no mobility ability, so pull her with Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab or close in with Blitzcrank W Overdrive and knock her up with Blitzcrank E Power Fist.
Soraka.phase: Late game, Blitzcrank struggles to kill a target alone, so pull only when your allies can follow up.
Soraka.teamfight: Target Soraka herself instead of continuing to hit only the target receiving heals. When your allies can follow up immediately, pull Soraka with Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab, then use Blitzcrank E Power Fist and R Static Field to give her less time to retaliate. Stay on her with Blitzcrank W Overdrive and keep up pressure so your allies can continue attacking.

Taric.watch: Sidestep when you see Taric E Dazzle wind up. Do not unload your attacks while the damage immunity from Taric R Cosmic Radiance is active.
Taric.build: Build magic resistance first against the damage from Taric P Bravado and Taric E Dazzle. Later, items that increase maximum mana help strengthen Blitzcrank P Mana Barrier.
Taric.fight: Trade after dodging Taric E Dazzle. Trading basic attacks up close lets Taric P Bravado bring his abilities back sooner, so knock him up with Blitzcrank E Power Fist and manage your distance. Taric has relatively low magic resistance, so Blitzcrank’s main magic damage hits him hard.
Taric.combo: If Taric E Dazzle is down, activate Blitzcrank E Power Fist just before Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab lands. Knock him up as soon as he is pulled in, then finish with Blitzcrank R Static Field. If a grab is hard to line up, approach from a brush with Blitzcrank W Overdrive, knock him up first with Blitzcrank E Power Fist, then land Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab.
Taric.escape: Go in after dodging Taric E Dazzle or just after Taric uses it. Taric has no ability to create distance on his own, so use that opening to chain Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab into Blitzcrank E Power Fist.
Taric.phase: Later in the game, Blitzcrank struggles to kill a target alone, so pull only when your allies can follow up immediately.
Taric.teamfight: When you see the cast animation for Taric R Cosmic Radiance, decide whether to keep attacking before the damage immunity takes effect or retreat with your allies. Pull a target your allies can attack when the immunity ends, and maintain pressure with Blitzcrank E Power Fist and Blitzcrank W Overdrive.
Taric.laning: Minions block Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab, so look for a moment when Taric moves away from them. Back off while Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab is on cooldown, and manage your distance so Taric has trouble using Taric P Bravado basic attacks while staying near the minions.

Thresh.watch: Dodge Thresh Q Death Sentence by moving sideways when you see him raise his hook. Be especially sure to change direction again when going in for a last hit. Avoid the line between Thresh and his ally so Thresh E Flay can’t pull you toward them.
Thresh.build: Thresh’s threat comes from locking you down with Thresh Q Death Sentence and Thresh E Flay while his allies add damage, so prioritize tenacity. If you build resistance against Thresh’s ability damage, choose magic resistance.
Thresh.fight: After sidestepping Thresh Q Death Sentence, close the gap and trade when he steps forward to collect a soul. Your approach is visible, so check that Thresh’s crowd control is down and start from a brush.
Thresh.laning: Control brush vision to conceal the range of Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab, and look for Thresh to step away from minions. If Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab hits a minion or misses, you will struggle to threaten him for a while, so save it when the angle is uncertain and do not step forward while it is on cooldown.
Thresh.combo: When you have an angle to pull Thresh, activate Blitzcrank E Power Fist just before Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab lands. Knock him up as soon as he arrives, then follow with Blitzcrank R Static Field. Use Blitzcrank R Static Field immediately if you need to remove the shield from Thresh W Dark Passage.
Thresh.escape: The moment after dodging Thresh Q Death Sentence is your chance to close the gap. If Thresh W Dark Passage is also down and has not come back up, engage with Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab and Blitzcrank E Power Fist. If Thresh E Flay is still available, avoid a position where it can pull you in.
Thresh.phase: Thresh grows tankier as he collects souls. Later in the game, Blitzcrank struggles to finish a target alone, so make sure your allies can follow up.
Thresh.teamfight: Use Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab only on a target your allies can follow up on immediately, then knock the target up with Blitzcrank E Power Fist to keep up the pressure. If Thresh W Dark Passage appears, decide whether to finish the target immediately or retreat. If you are trapped by Thresh R The Box, choose a direction to break out and have your tankiest ally cross one wall first.

Velkoz.watch: Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission splits to both sides even if you dodge the initial projectile, so do not dodge only sideways; move toward Vel'Koz or behind the projectile after it passes. If consecutive hits from Vel'Koz’s abilities have built up stacks of Vel'Koz P Organic Deconstruction, back off and let them expire. When Vel'Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray starts, interrupt it with Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab or Blitzcrank E Power Fist.
Velkoz.build: Prioritize magic resistance over armor against Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission, Vel'Koz W Void Rift, and Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption. Resistance cannot prevent the true damage from Vel'Koz P Organic Deconstruction and Vel'Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray, so build health as well. Movement speed to leave telegraphed areas of effect and maximum mana to strengthen Blitzcrank P Mana Barrier are also useful.
Velkoz.fight: After dodging Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption, close the gap with Blitzcrank W Overdrive and fight. Vel'Koz has no mobility ability, making him easy to catch, but Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption can knock you back at close range, so be ready to chain Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab and Blitzcrank E Power Fist. Do not approach through consecutive poke; back off first if stacks of Vel'Koz P Organic Deconstruction build up.
Velkoz.laning: Control brush vision to conceal the range of Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab, and pull Vel'Koz when he steps away from minions. Minions block Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab, and its cost is high early, so save it when the angle is uncertain and use the threat of holding it. Clearing river and tri-brush vision creates a path to approach from the side and makes it harder for Vel'Koz to step forward to poke.
Velkoz.combo: When Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption is down, pull him with Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab, knock him up with Blitzcrank E Power Fist, and finish with Blitzcrank R Static Field. Activating Blitzcrank E Power Fist just before Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab lands lets you knock him up the moment he arrives. If Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab is hard to line up, close in from a brush with Blitzcrank W Overdrive, knock him up first with Blitzcrank E Power Fist, then follow with Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab.
Velkoz.escape: The moment after Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption is used is your chance to engage with Blitzcrank W Overdrive. Vel'Koz has no mobility ability, so catch him with Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab and Blitzcrank E Power Fist once you close the gap. Blitzcrank slows himself when Blitzcrank W Overdrive ends, so delay the engage if you would take consecutive hits from Vel'Koz’s poke.
Velkoz.phase: Later in the game, Blitzcrank struggles to kill a target alone, so pull Vel'Koz only when your allies can follow up immediately.
Velkoz.teamfight: When Vel'Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray starts, prioritize interrupting its channel with Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab or Blitzcrank E Power Fist. After engaging, stay on the target with Blitzcrank E Power Fist and Blitzcrank W Overdrive to help your allies follow up.

Xerath.watch: Be especially careful before engaging: a stun from Xerath E Shocking Orb can leave you exposed to follow-up attacks. Xerath Q Arcanopulse passes through minions, so change direction and sidestep when you see him charging it. Watch for the slow from Xerath W Eye of Destruction. When you see the cast animation for Xerath R Rite of the Arcane, dodge immediately or engage on Xerath while he cannot move.
Xerath.build: First consider a way to block or remove the stun from Xerath E Shocking Orb. Xerath’s main ability damage is all magic, so build magic resistance. Movement speed also helps you leave telegraphed attack areas.
Xerath.fight: Just after Xerath E Shocking Orb and Xerath W Eye of Destruction are used, close the gap with Blitzcrank W Overdrive. Xerath has no mobility ability, so knock him up with Blitzcrank E Power Fist once you get close, then catch him with Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab. Blitzcrank’s main magic damage also hits Xerath hard because his magic resistance is relatively low.
Xerath.laning: Control brush vision to conceal the range of Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab, and look for a grab when Xerath steps away from minions. Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab has a high mana cost and a long cooldown early, so save it when the angle is uncertain and back off after using it. Avoid Xerath’s heavy damage and hold out until mana runs low, then push the lane and call for jungle help.
Xerath.combo: If Xerath steps away from minions, pull him with Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab. Activate Blitzcrank E Power Fist just before it lands to knock him up as soon as he arrives, and finish with Blitzcrank R Static Field if you need immediate damage or a silence. If a grab is hard to line up, wait until Xerath’s crowd control is down, approach from a brush with Blitzcrank W Overdrive, land Blitzcrank E Power Fist first, then follow with Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab.
Xerath.escape: Xerath has no mobility ability, so you do not need to wait for one to be used. The moment after Xerath E Shocking Orb and Xerath W Eye of Destruction are used is your opening to go in. Xerath also cannot move while casting Xerath R Rite of the Arcane, so you can engage on him there.
Xerath.phase: Later in the game, Blitzcrank struggles to kill a target alone, so attempt only grabs your allies can follow up on.
Xerath.teamfight: When your allies can follow up immediately, pull Xerath with Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab and knock him up with Blitzcrank E Power Fist. Follow with Blitzcrank R Static Field if you need an immediate silence, then stay on the target with Blitzcrank E Power Fist and Blitzcrank W Overdrive to maintain pressure.

Zilean.watch: If Zilean Q Time Bomb attaches twice, you will be stunned, so as soon as the first bomb attaches, move away from your allies and out of its blast radius. If Zilean E Time Warp catches you alone, you are vulnerable to the bomb combo, so avoid engaging alone.
Zilean.build: Prioritize tenacity against the stun from Zilean Q Time Bomb and the slow from Zilean E Time Warp. Zilean deals magic damage, so build magic resistance afterward. Increasing maximum mana also strengthens Blitzcrank P Mana Barrier.
Zilean.fight: Zilean has no mobility skill and relatively low magic resistance, so close the gap and catch him with Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab and Blitzcrank E Power Fist. Blitzcrank's main magic damage also works well against him. If Zilean E Time Warp is available, do not dive in alone; approach from different directions with your allies.
Zilean.combo: When Zilean is away from the minions, pull him with Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab. Activate Blitzcrank E Power Fist just before the grab lands so you can knock him up as soon as he arrives. Follow with Blitzcrank R Static Field if you need to finish him immediately or silence him. If there is no grab angle, wait until his crowd control is down, approach with Blitzcrank W Overdrive, knock him up first with Blitzcrank E Power Fist, then land Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab.
Zilean.escape: Your opening is after Zilean E Time Warp is used or after the Zilean Q Time Bomb → Zilean W Rewind → Zilean Q Time Bomb combo. Zilean has no mobility skill, so close the gap then and catch him with Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab and Blitzcrank E Power Fist.
Zilean.phase: Late in the game, Blitzcrank has trouble killing a target alone, so pull only when your allies can follow up immediately.
Zilean.teamfight: Pull a target your allies can attack immediately with Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab, knock them up with Blitzcrank E Power Fist, then stay close and keep up the pressure. If an enemy damage dealer has Zilean R Chronoshift, target the fragile Zilean instead. Do not use abilities on a target while they are reviving; look to act when Zilean R Chronoshift expires or just after they revive.

Zyra.watch: If Zyra E Grasping Roots hits, the root makes you vulnerable to follow-up plant damage, so dodge sideways at the edge of its range. When the indicator for Zyra R Stranglethorns appears, use Blitzcrank W Overdrive to walk out of its area. Don’t fight where there are lots of plants; back off briefly.
Zyra.build: Prioritize movement speed to get out of telegraphed areas. Blitzcrank has no skill to escape on his own, so prioritize tenacity against Zyra E Grasping Roots and Zyra R Stranglethorns. If building resistances, choose magic resistance over armor.
Zyra.fight: Engage after dodging Zyra E Grasping Roots, when there are no plants. Zyra has no skill to create distance on her own, so pull her with Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab and knock her up with Blitzcrank E Power Fist. Do not force a trade where plants are set up; back off and wait for them to disappear.
Zyra.laning: Control brush vision to conceal the range of Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab, and look for a grab when Zyra is away from the minions. Sidestep Zyra E Grasping Roots before engaging, and do not walk in to step on seeds while Zyra is using her abilities. Do not step forward while Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab is on cooldown.
Zyra.combo: Activate Blitzcrank E Power Fist just before Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab lands, knock up Zyra as soon as she is pulled in, then finish with Blitzcrank R Static Field. If Zyra E Grasping Roots is down and a grab is difficult, close in with Blitzcrank W Overdrive, knock her up first with Blitzcrank E Power Fist, then land Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab.
Zyra.escape: The moment after you dodge Zyra E Grasping Roots is your opening. Zyra has no skill to create distance, so catch her then with Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab and Blitzcrank E Power Fist. If Zyra E Grasping Roots is still available, avoid opening by rushing in with Blitzcrank W Overdrive.
Zyra.phase: Late in the game, it is hard to kill a target alone after pulling them in, so grab only when your allies can follow up immediately.
Zyra.teamfight: Do not fight where Zyra has built up plants. Move to another objective and fight in a new position. Pull Zyra with Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab when your allies can attack her immediately, then knock her up with Blitzcrank E Power Fist. After starting the fight, stay on the target with Blitzcrank E Power Fist and Blitzcrank W Overdrive to help your allies follow up.
